source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons layer 3

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public Historic England Listed Building polygons feature payload for ListEntry 1239561 (Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter), including returned Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates and bound ListEntry/Name/Grade fields. Historic England's official polygon-layer metadata states that polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011 and that area_ha is populated only where a building footprint has been mapped; the official NHLE entry identifies this record as a pair of early-C19 detached villas, Grade II, most recently amended 19 July 2016. The exact record query with returnGeometry=true was not retrievable through the available web channel, so no polygon coordinates were read or inferred and no individual building record was accepted.
